description: This file defines data structures, enums, and constants related to positioning and transmission point (TRP) information exchange in a 5G NR context, including PRS configurations, beam info, and location accuracy.

classes.name: trp_information_type_item_t
classes.description: Enumeration of different TRP information types.

classes.name: dl_prs_muting_pattern_t
classes.description: Structure representing a PRS muting pattern with length and value.

classes.name: prs_muting_option1_t
classes.description: PRS muting option 1 with muting pattern and repeat factor.

classes.name: prs_muting_option2_t
classes.description: PRS muting option 2 with muting pattern.

classes.name: prs_muting_t
classes.description: Optional muting options for PRS.

classes.name: prs_resource_qcl_source_prs_t
classes.description: QCL source PRS resource with set ID and optional resource ID.

classes.name: prs_res_item_t
classes.description: PRS resource item with identifiers, offsets, and optional QCL info.

classes.name: prs_resource_set_item_t
classes.description: PRS resource set configuration including bandwidth, periodicity, and muting.

classes.name: prs_cfg_t
classes.description: Configuration containing a list of PRS resource sets.

classes.name: prs_angle_item_t
classes.description: PRS beam angle information with azimuth and elevation.

classes.name: nr_prs_beam_info_item_t
classes.description: Beam info item with resource set ID and angle list.

classes.name: lcs_to_gcs_translation_item_t
classes.description: Translation parameters from local to global coordinate systems.

classes.name: nr_prs_beam_info_t
classes.description: Beam information including list of beam angles and translations.

classes.name: spatial_direction_info_t
classes.description: Contains beam info for spatial direction.

classes.name: ng_ran_high_accuracy_access_point_position_t
classes.description: High accuracy position with latitude, longitude, altitude, and uncertainties.

classes.name: trp_position_direct_accuracy_t
classes.description: Variant for position accuracy, either general or high accuracy.

classes.name: trp_position_direct_t
classes.description: Direct position with accuracy.

classes.name: ref_point_t
classes.description: Reference point variant, including coordinate or position.

classes.name: location_uncertainty_t
classes.description: Uncertainty metrics for location.

classes.name: relative_geodetic_location_t
classes.description: Geodetic location with delta values and uncertainty.

classes.name: height_units_t
classes.description: Units for height measurement.

classes.name: milli_arc_second_units_t
classes.description: Units for angular measurement in milli-arc seconds.

classes.name: xyz_unit_t
classes.description: Units for Cartesian coordinates.

classes.name: relative_cartesian_location_t
classes.description: Cartesian location with delta values and uncertainty.

classes.name: trp_ref_point_type_t
classes.description: Variant for reference point type.

classes.name: trp_position_direct_t
classes.description: Direct position with accuracy.

classes.name: trp_position_refd_t
classes.description: Referenced position with ref point and type.

classes.name: trp_position_definition_type_t
classes.description: Variant for position definition type.

classes.name: dl_prs_res_set_arp_location_t
classes.description: ARP location variant for resource set.

classes.name: dl_prs_res_arp_t
classes.description: ARP resource with ID and location.

classes.name: dl_prs_res_set_arp_t
classes.description: ARP resource set with ID, location, and list of ARP resources.

classes.name: dl_prs_res_coordinates_t
classes.description: Coordinates for PRS resources.

classes.name: arp_location_type_t
classes.description: Variant for ARP location type.

classes.name: arp_location_info_item_t
classes.description: ARP location info with ID and type.

classes.name: geographical_coordinates_t
classes.description: Contains position definition, coordinates, and ARP info.

classes.name: trp_type_t
classes.description: Enumeration of TRP types.

classes.name: on_demand_prs_info_t
classes.description: PRS info for on-demand configuration.

classes.name: dl_prs_res_id_item_t
classes.description: PRS resource ID item.

classes.name: trpteg_item_t
classes.description: TRP transmission element group with resource set and resource IDs.

classes.name: trp_beam_pwr_item_t
classes.description: Beam power info with relative power and fine adjustment.

classes.name: trp_elevation_angle_list_item_t
classes.description: Elevation angle with optional fine adjustment and beam power list.

classes.name: trp_beam_ant_angles_list_item_t
classes.description: Azimuth and elevation list for beam angles.

classes.name: trp_beam_ant_explicit_info_t
classes.description: Explicit beam antenna info with angles and optional translation.

classes.name: choice_trp_beam_ant_info_item_t
classes.description: Variant for beam antenna info item.

classes.name: trp_beam_ant_info_t
classes.description: Beam antenna info with variant choice.

classes.name: trp_information_type_response_item_t
classes.description: Variant of different TRP information response types.

classes.name: trp_info_t
classes.description: TRP info with ID and list of information types.

classes.name: trp_information_list_trp_response_item_t
classes.description: TRP response item containing TRP info.
